narrative.overview:
This system is built for agents who live inside it. Not a dashboard you visit once a day — a workspace you occupy for eight hours, resolving citizen requests through WhatsApp at volume. The visual grammar reflects that context precisely: every pixel serves function, density is a virtue, and decoration competes with the task and loses.

The palette is near-black zinc with a single, precise emerald accent. The zinc surfaces recede so that content — names, messages, statuses, timestamps — reads at a glance. The emerald ("Live Current") appears only where it carries meaning: an active ticket, a confirmed send, a live connection, the outgoing message bubble. Its rarity makes it a reliable signal.

This system explicitly rejects the aesthetic of generic SaaS helpdesks — HubSpot, Zendesk, Freshdesk — with their beige-white surfaces and padding sized for comfort rather than throughput. It equally rejects the WhatsApp Web clone reflex: this interface handles WhatsApp data but is a professional operator tool, not a reskin of a consumer app.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-only. No light mode. The zinc surface IS the product identity.
Single accent. Live Current (emerald) is used for active state, primary action, and live indicators only. Never for decoration.
Tonal layering, not shadows. Depth is conveyed by stepping through the zinc ramp. Shadows are reserved for floating layers.
Dense and direct. Components are sized for operators who scan, not users who browse.
One typeface. Geist Variable across all roles. Weight and size carry the entire hierarchy.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Live Current appears on ≤15% of any given screen surface. Reserve it for primary actions, active states, and live indicators. If multiple elements are emerald, at least one is wrong.

rules.name: The Tint Rule
rules.body: Semantic color backgrounds use the base color at 8–15% opacity, never at full saturation. A green-tinted badge is a status cue; a fully green cell is noise.

rules.name: The Tonal-First Rule
rules.body: Before adding a shadow to separate two surfaces, step one up or down the zinc ladder. Shadows on resting surfaces indicate a modeling failure.

rules.name: The Glow Reserve Rule
rules.body: The emerald glow is a signature material, not a hover pattern. At most two elements per screen may carry it. Standard focus is a border-color shift to rgba(16,185,129,0.35).

rules.name: The No-Display-Font Rule
rules.body: Geist Variable is the only typeface. No serif, no condensed, no mono for UI chrome.

rules.name: The Uppercase Ceiling
rules.body: All-caps applies to Label-scale text only: 10–11px, four words maximum. Never to button labels, error messages, or descriptions.

dos: Do use tonal surface steps before shadows when separating adjacent panels.
Do reserve Live Current for primary actions, active/selected states, and live indicators only.
Do use the five badge variants (green, yellow, blue, gray, indigo) as the complete status vocabulary.
Do use the small (-sm) button and compact padding inside panels and forms.
Do use Geist font-feature settings (cv02, cv03, cv04, cv11) on every text context.
Do size focus rings as a border-color shift to rgba(16,185,129,0.35).
Do use sentence case for all interactive labels, button text, error messages, and descriptive copy.
Do use rgba(255,255,255,0.06) as the divider between adjacent surfaces of the same depth.
donts: Don't apply the HubSpot / Zendesk / Freshdesk aesthetic: no light surfaces, no rounded blue primary buttons, no generous padding for comfort.
Don't make the chat interface look like WhatsApp Web. WhatsApp's teal header, green status bars, and consumer iconography are prohibited.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe on nav items, cards, or list rows.
Don't apply background-clip: text with a gradient fill to any text element.
Don't use the emerald glow as a general hover or focus style.
Don't introduce a light mode or light-surface variant.
Don't add decorative motion: no page-load entrances, no staggered list animations, no scroll-driven choreography.
Don't use glassmorphism as a default surface style.
Don't apply uppercase to body text, button labels, dialog content, or error messages.
Don't introduce new accent hues. Violet and blue are semantic-only. Live Current is the only brand color.
